headline: My Relationships, from entry to detail
overview: My Relationships is your personal contact directory for meaningful people in your life. Add contacts and then compare personality test results side-by-side to gain insight into compatibility, communication styles, and potential friction points. It bridges your inner self-knowledge with your understanding of the people around you.
targetAudience: Users interested in relationships tools for personal growth and self-discovery.

keyFeatures: Add and manage contacts representing meaningful people in your life
Side-by-side comparison of personality test results between you and a contact
Insights into compatibility and communication style differences
Link contacts to your social network graph for a complete relationship picture
tips: Add contacts whose personality types you already know for the most useful comparisons
Use the side-by-side comparison before important conversations to anticipate how they might receive your message
